settings.question: When will my order be shipped?
settings.answer: We process and ship orders on business days within 24 hours of receiving payment. For cash on delivery orders, we ship within 24 hours of order confirmation.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Delivery usually takes 1-3 business days from shipment, depending on the chosen shipping method and destination.

settings.question: What payment options are available?
settings.answer: We offer several payment options: online credit card payment, bank transfer, or cash on delivery when receiving the goods.

settings.question: How can I return an item?
settings.answer: You can return items within 14 days of receipt. Simply fill out the return form found in the 'Returns' section and send it along with the item to our address.

settings.question: What warranty do your products have?
settings.answer: All our products come with a standard 24-month legal warranty. Some products may have an extended warranty, which is specified in the product description.
